description: This file contains SwiftUI view extensions for the OnboardingView, defining multiple onboarding pages, sections, and UI components related to onboarding, setup, permissions, and agent workspace configuration for the OpenClaw application on macOS.

methods.name: pageView(for:)
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate onboarding page view based on the page index.

methods.name: welcomePage()
methods.description: Constructs the welcome page UI with security notices and introductory information.

methods.name: connectionPage()
methods.description: Constructs the connection setup page UI, including local and remote gateway options.

methods.name: gatewayDiscoverySection()
methods.description: Displays available nearby gateways and allows refreshing the discovery.

methods.name: advancedConnectionSection()
methods.description: Handles advanced connection settings like transport type and gateway URL configuration.

methods.name: permissionsPage()
methods.description: UI for requesting and displaying permissions required by OpenClaw.

methods.name: cliPage()
methods.description: Provides UI for installing or re-installing the OpenClaw CLI tool.

methods.name: workspacePage()
methods.description: UI for setting up or viewing the agent workspace directory.

methods.name: onboardingChatPage()
methods.description: Displays a dedicated onboarding chat interface to introduce the agent.

methods.name: readyPage()
methods.description: Final onboarding page summarizing setup and providing quick action links.
